newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya security breaks up "illegal" protest.
newsitem.headline: Kenya security breaks up "illegal" protest.

text.p: Kenyan security forces fought running battles with demonstrators in Nairobi on Saturday after breaking up a banned protest rally by opposition and church leaders demanding constitutional change.

Police and paramilitary units fired teargas grenades and wielded billyclubs to drive around 2,000 protesters out of central Uhuru Park and then fought battles with protesters, effectively closing central Nairobi.
There was no immediate news on arrests and injuries.

"We are here to defy the illegal law called the Public Order Act because it is against the constitution, which states that there is freedom of assembly and association," opposition FORD Asili MP Martin Shikuku told Reuters.
Kenya's government declared the rally illegal on Friday, warning the public not to attend.
